About Me

I am Hanzhen Bao. This website brings together my mathematical reading notes, seminar materials, and reflections from discussion.

My reading follows connections between topology, differentiable manifolds, and geometry, with particular attention to examples and the ideas behind proofs.

About My Mentors

Mathematical reading grows through conversation. This section will introduce the mentors who help guide the seminar through questions, explanations, and feedback.

Their academic profiles, research interests, and contributions to our discussions will be collected here.

More Information About the Textbooks Used

The seminar draws on textbooks in topology, differentiable manifolds, and Riemann geometry. Each reading group will list its chosen text and the chapters discussed.

Additional references, comments on prerequisites, and suggestions for further reading will be added as the program develops.
